edges.reason: onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before ownership can be transferred.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner to finalize the transfer.
onlyOwner modifier gates the privileged external token sweep.
Contract owner is initialized directly from msg.sender, giving the deployer full privileges.
msg.sender balance is debited and used as the Transfer event source.
msg.sender is the allowance owner key written in approve.
msg.sender's allowance is spent in transferFrom.
msg.sender is approved and forwarded as 'from' in the callback.
approveAndCall performs an external call to the spender contract while state is already written.
The spender contract can re-enter approveAndCall during receiveApproval.
Re-entrancy from the external call can invoke transferFrom and drain allowances.
transferAnyERC20Token delegates execution to an arbitrary token contract.
A malicious token contract can re-enter the owner-only sweep function.
The spender parameter directly controls the destination of the external call.
The tokens parameter is passed into the external receiveApproval call.
The data parameter is forwarded verbatim to the external callee.
Recipient parameter receives the credited balance in transfer.
Amount parameter is subtracted from sender and added to recipient.
Spender parameter is the key written in the allowed mapping.
Tokens parameter is the allowance value stored for the spender.
Source address parameter is debited inside transferFrom.
Destination address parameter is credited inside transferFrom.
Amount parameter is removed from source and added to destination.
New owner address parameter is written into the privileged newOwner state variable.
Token contract address parameter determines the external call target.
Token amount parameter is forwarded to the external transfer.
tokenOwner parameter indexes the balances mapping.
tokenOwner parameter is the outer key of the allowed mapping lookup.
spender parameter is the inner key of the allowed mapping lookup.
transfer writes updated balances for sender and recipient.
transferFrom writes updated balances for from and to.
transferFrom decreases the spender allowance in allowed.
approve overwrites the allowance entry for msg.sender and spender.
transferOwnership writes the pending owner into newOwner.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner to owner.
acceptOwnership clears newOwner to address(0).
Constructor sets the fixed _totalSupply value.
Constructor pre-mints the entire supply to a fixed address.
totalSupply performs an unchecked subtraction without SafeMath.
Unchecked subtraction reads _totalSupply as the minuend.
Unchecked subtraction uses balances[address(0)] as the subtrahend.
Spender parameter is granted the allowance before the external call.
Swept tokens are always sent to the privileged owner address.

Tokens parameter is only stored as the allowance value in approve.
Source address parameter is consumed only by transferFrom.
Destination address parameter is consumed only by transferFrom.
Amount parameter is consumed only by transferFrom.
Spender parameter is the target of the unsafe external call node.
Tokens parameter only feeds approval and callback argument passing.
Opaque data parameter is forwarded into the external call payload.
Parameter is only assigned to the newOwner state variable inside transferOwnership.
